summary: Iteratively styled the ChangesPanel to show a divider between Unstaged and Staged groups with distinct background tints (warning for unstaged, success for staged). Tagged folder and file rows with data-group attributes so the entire card area inherits the group background, and added a data-group-header attribute to scope the divider border to the staged header only.
decisions: Folder rows and file rows are tagged with data-group='staged' or 'unstaged' via a nodeGroup() helper so nested rows inherit the correct group background
The divider between groups is rendered as a border-top on the staged group header (data-group='staged'][data-group-header]) rather than a pseudo-element on a wrapper, so it sits flush with the header
Group background tints: 5% color-mix for folder headers, 5% for file rows; warning color for unstaged, success color for staged
The collapsed-folders Set was converted from SvelteSet to a $state-managed Set with immutable replacement on toggle, to ensure reactivity
errors: An edit tool call to apps/app/src/styles/changes.css failed validation because edits was missing the required edits property
